item.title: A simpler rule beat the hierarchy on GPT-2. Here’s what that means.
item.author: hello@ephemerent.com (Kenju Tomita)
item.description: A controlled experiment rewarded a sophisticated compression hierarchy. A small GPT-2 test did not. The reversal became the real result.
item.content:encoded:
I built a sophisticated hierarchy to compress neural networks without erasing rare-domain behavior. It worked perfectly in a controlled setting. On GPT-2, a much simpler robust baseline did better at aggressive compression—and that became the real result.
